text: ‘Transnational organisations have been unsuccessful in reducing global poverty.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
OR
‘Governments are unable to prevent the increase of global crime.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The media has only an indirect influence on social behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Control of the media is shared between different groups.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion is an instrument of ideological control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religion has little role in people’s lives today.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
